COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
C482 No. 1482 of 2022
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Sachin Kumar Sharma, Advocate, for the
applicants.
Mr. Pratiroop Pandey, A.G.A., assisted by
Mrs. Mamta Joshi, Brief Holder, for the State of
Uttarakhand.
Mr. Kurban Ali, Advocate, has put in
appearance on behalf of respondent No. 2.
After arguing for some length, the learned
counsel for the applicants, seeks permission to
withdraw the C482 Application with liberty to file a
fresh.
The permission, as sought for, is granted.
The C482 Application is dismissed as
withdrawn with the liberty to file a fresh, subject to
the condition that, whenever the applicants file a
fresh C482 Application, they would be serving
notices on the counsel for respondent No.2, who
has put in appearance for respondent today.
The certified copy of the impugned orders,
which had been filed along with the C482
Application, would be returned to the applicants by
substituting it with the zerox copy.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 25.08.2022
Shiv
